text: Taken up as tasks/028 and landed, except the outside test. (1) literature_span@v1 (081a3ae): the span [lowest, highest] of the values and stated ranges of one quantity, each entry naming its material and saying how its system compares; nothing from fewer than two values and no stated range; worked cases on three unrelated kinds read from materials (d6bca5a). (2) tolerance_from_reference@v5 (081a3ae) and template v28 (8d2d786): the rule's branches in order, the span after a stated uncertainty and before the printed digit and the run's error, recorded as an interval, chosen_by rule, from literature_span; test_template_v28 on two unrelated kinds. (3) The builder derives the span from a task's measure.materials and refuses an entry that names no material or does not say how it compares; that the Designer looks for such materials first is the session skills' to say, asked of the design role in this seat's next note. Not done: a test of a built bundle deriving a span from cards it was not handed, which needs a run. For the water count no source gives a second value or a range (meta_agent/failures.jsonl span-1).
